title: Ohm’s law and circuit basics
coverage: Ohm’s law; basic electrical circuits; supporting voltage and current division
inputs: Voltage, resistance, series/parallel selector
visual: Circuit values, current arrows, V–I graph and resistor power
challenge: Predict current before doubling resistance
check: I=V/R; divider output agrees with direct circuit solution

title: KCL and KVL
coverage: Kirchhoff’s Current Law and Voltage Law
inputs: Two source values, three resistors, node/loop selection
visual: Signed node currents and loop voltage drops with running residual
challenge: Find the incorrect sign and close the balance
check: KCL and KVL residuals below 1e-9 of the solution scale

title: Node analysis
inputs: Two-node resistor network, source values, reference node
visual: Node voltages, labelled branch currents and equation matrix
challenge: Write two KCL equations before revealing the solution
check: Two-node solution matches an independent linear solver; reject singular networks

title: Mesh analysis
inputs: Two mesh sources, shared resistor, mesh directions
visual: Loop equations, mesh currents and shared-branch difference
challenge: Explain why the shared current is I1−I2
check: Both mesh voltage residuals vanish; branch currents match nodal analysis

title: Source transformation
inputs: Source amplitude and positive source resistance
visual: Equivalent source pair and identical load V–I curves
challenge: Identify which internal quantity is not preserved
check: Vs=IsRs; terminal voltage and current agree for at least three loads

title: Superposition theorem
inputs: Two sources, resistor values, source activation toggles
visual: Per-source contributions and signed total branch current
challenge: Explain why powers cannot be added by superposition
check: Sum of source contributions equals full linear circuit solution; ideal source deactivation correct

title: Thevenin and Norton equivalents
inputs: Source network and load resistance
visual: Original/equivalent circuits, open-circuit voltage and load curve
challenge: Predict load current using both equivalents
check: Vth=InRth; original, Thevenin and Norton load responses agree

title: Reciprocity theorem
coverage: Reciprocity in eligible linear bilateral networks
inputs: Source location, response branch, resistor values
visual: Swap excitation and response branches while retaining polarity
challenge: State why the theorem needs eligibility conditions
check: Transfer responses agree after swapping source/measurement in valid single-source networks

title: Maximum power transfer
inputs: Thevenin voltage/resistance and load resistance
visual: Load-power graph, operating point and efficiency
challenge: Find maximum load power and compare its efficiency
check: Peak at RL=Rth for resistive DC; efficiency at that point is 50%

title: Wye–delta transformation
inputs: Three positive branch resistances and conversion direction
visual: Switchable Y/Δ drawing and terminal-resistance verification
challenge: Verify equivalent resistance between two terminals
check: Round-trip conversion and all three terminal resistances agree

title: Sinusoids, RMS and phase
coverage: Sinusoidal waveforms; phase; RMS as enabling concept
inputs: Amplitude, frequency, phase and time cursor
visual: Waveform, rotating arrow and RMS/peak comparison
challenge: Distinguish frequency change from phase shift
check: Sine RMS=peak/√2; period=1/f; degree/radian conversion consistent

title: Phasor Lab
coverage: Phasors; complex impedance; series and parallel RL/RC/RLC AC analysis
inputs: R, L, C, source voltage, frequency, topology
visual: Live voltage/current phasors, circuit, waveform and worked calculation
challenge: Compare series and parallel current near resonance
check: Existing series/parallel regressions, KVL/KCL and lead/lag checks remain passing

title: Complex power and power factor
coverage: Complex power; active/reactive/apparent power; power factor
inputs: RLC load, RMS source, optional shunt correction capacitor
visual: Power triangle, instantaneous power and P/Q/S values
challenge: Reduce reactive power without changing useful resistive power
check: S=VI*; |S|²=P²+Q²; passive inductor Q positive and capacitor Q negative

title: RC and RL transients
coverage: Transient response of RC and RL circuits; time constants
inputs: R, C or L, source step, initial capacitor voltage/inductor current
visual: Time waveform, initial/final values, τ cursor and energy
challenge: Locate 63.2% of the total change at one time constant
check: RC τ=RthC; RL τ=L/Rth; state continuity and t=0/∞ limits correct

title: RLC damping and step response
inputs: R, L, C, initial voltage/current, source step
visual: Underdamped, critically damped and overdamped traces
challenge: Find the resistance that removes oscillation without slow overdamping
check: Series RLC critical R=2√(L/C); state continuity and energy balance verified

title: From circuit to differential equation
inputs: RC/RL/series-RLC selector and reference polarities
visual: Circuit law → state variables → differential equation → numerical trace
challenge: Choose the correct derivative term for each component
check: Model agrees with analytic first-order response; solver converges under timestep refinement

title: Resonance, bandwidth and Q
inputs: R, L, C, sweep bounds and series/parallel topology
visual: Frequency sweep, f0 marker, half-power points and reactive cancellation
challenge: Compare series maximum current with ideal parallel minimum current
check: f0=1/(2π√LC); define output before BW/Q; correct ideal series versus shunt-R parallel formulas

title: Bode plots and frequency response
coverage: Bode plots; frequency response; RC/RL filters as teaching examples
inputs: Circuit/output node, R, C or L, logarithmic frequency range
visual: Magnitude in dB and unwrapped phase with cutoff cursor
challenge: Explain why gain depends on the selected output node
check: H(jω) validated; first-order cutoff −3.0103 dB; asymptotic slope ±20 dB/decade

title: Intrinsic and extrinsic semiconductors
inputs: Intrinsic/n-type/p-type selector, qualitative doping and temperature
visual: Electron/hole concentration and band diagrams with explicit model limits
challenge: Explain why majority and minority carriers coexist
check: Use qualitative labels unless calibrated parameters justify numerical carrier estimates

title: PN junction diode
inputs: Bias voltage, series resistor, temperature and model selector
visual: I–V characteristic, circuit operating point and junction explanation
challenge: Compare ideal, constant-drop and exponential models
check: No exponential overflow; series resistance limits current; model assumptions visible

title: Zener diode and regulation
coverage: Zener diode characteristics; regulator as application
inputs: Supply voltage, series resistance, load and nominal Zener voltage
visual: Regulation region, load line, current sharing and power limit
challenge: Find when the Zener leaves regulation
check: KCL and resistor dissipation valid; knee/current-limit conditions handled

title: LED, photodiode and solar cell
inputs: Device selector, current limit, light level, solar load
visual: LED current/power, photodiode response and solar I–V/P–V curves
challenge: Explain why a photodiode and solar cell use different operating points
check: Current/power bounded; optical/solar models identify illustrative versus calibrated quantities

title: BJT characteristics
coverage: BJT characteristic curves and operating regions
inputs: Base current, VCE, beta, collector supply and resistor
visual: Output curves, DC load line and cutoff/active/saturation marker
challenge: Identify why IC=βIB fails in saturation
check: No active-region formula beyond compliance; terminal current continuity maintained

title: MOSFET characteristics
inputs: VGS, VDS, threshold and simplified device parameters
visual: Transfer curve, output family and cutoff/linear/saturation region
challenge: Explain why threshold voltage is not a full-on specification
check: Region boundaries continuous within chosen model; simplified square-law limitations stated

title: Rectifiers and ripple
inputs: Half-wave/full-wave/bridge, AC amplitude/frequency, load and optional filter
visual: Conduction path, input/output waveforms, average output and ripple
challenge: Compare ripple frequency for half-wave and full-wave circuits
check: Ideal waveform mean and bridge diode drops verified; capacitor charging solved consistently

title: Transistor bias and load line
inputs: Divider resistors, emitter/collector resistors, supply and beta
visual: DC operating point, load line and sensitivity to beta
challenge: Choose a Q point that permits symmetric signal swing
check: Divider loading included; region checked before reporting active-region solution

title: BJT as a switch
inputs: Supply, load, base resistance, input logic and forced beta
visual: Input/output timing, load state, base current and power
challenge: Size base resistance for a specified resistive load
check: Saturation/drive limits enforced; loss calculation agrees with VI; inductive model isolated if added

title: MOSFET as a switch
inputs: Gate drive, load, supply and RDS(on)
visual: Load current, gate state and conduction loss
challenge: Compare threshold voltage with the specified gate drive for RDS(on)
check: On-state loss=I²RDS(on); supported gate-drive assumptions explicit

title: SCR, DIAC and TRIAC
inputs: Device selector, gate pulse, source type and firing angle
visual: Device I–V, latching/holding state and AC conduction intervals
challenge: Explain why removing an SCR gate pulse does not turn it off
check: Latching/holding currents differentiated; AC zero-current commutation and device polarity verified

title: UJT and switching applications
inputs: Emitter RC values, supply and intrinsic stand-off ratio
visual: Capacitor ramp, peak/valley trigger state and pulse train
challenge: Predict how increasing timing capacitance changes pulse frequency
check: Peak/valley state transitions defined; simplified timing law used only in its valid approximation
